children.innerHTML: Five artists, alphabetical by feel. Flip through the sleeves sideways, the way you would in the shop, before shops closed at reasonable hours.

attributes.alt: Velvet Antenna: Synth-pop for empty motorways
Bad Comet: Garage rock, recorded in one
Marrow & Pine: Folk songs about rent
Nadia Reyes: Torch songs, modern heartbreak
Tape Hiss Club: Lo-fi collages from found audio
The crate at the listening bar

children.innerHTML: Somebody plays us something in the bar on a Friday. If the room goes quiet by the second chorus, we ask for a demo. If the office is still humming it on Monday, we book the studio. There is no other process. There has never been another process.
We sign for two records because the second one is always the honest one.

meta_description: Five artists, flipped through like a record crate: Velvet Antenna, Bad Comet, Marrow & Pine, Nadia Reyes, Tape Hiss Club.
